_comment: S3 (spec/rules/selection.md), W3.R11: pen-dom and pen-undo selection-setter calls that omit an origin on purpose (host-API forwarding, FieldEditor.focus() re-targeting). Each entry needs file, enclosing symbol, setter and reason; an entry with no matching call fails (I15).

entries.reason: Host API forwarding: the public FieldEditor.selection setter writes a host-chosen selection, which is programmatic.
Host API forwarding: FieldEditor.expandTo has no pen-dom caller; hosts reach it through expandFieldEditorRange.
Host API forwarding: FieldEditor.contractToFocused has no pen-dom caller; hosts reach it through contractFieldEditorRange.
